entries: `/rewind` lists only prompts you typed, and skips automatic runtime turns
Custom model tables in `config.toml` keep the original model notice banner
`read_file`, `search_replace`, and `grep` handle large files, special files, and binary content more reliably, and surface clearer errors
Ask rules for `WebSearch` and `WebFetch` show a prompt instead of running on their own
Cancelling one tool call no longer kills commands started by other parallel calls
After login, a refused prompt is not retried on its own; the sign-in block needs a manual resend
